title: eludite.view.show input
description: Show and activate a tool window (View menu, e.g. View > Solution Explorer) or a document tab. A closed tool window reopens where it was; an auto-hidden one slides out; a tabbed one becomes the active tab of its group.

id.description: Tool window id (e.g. solution_explorer, properties, error_list, output, toolbox, git_changes) or document tab id.
